notes.title: Version 0.27 is online !
notes.content:
Changelog :

- [Added] New Sponsors system : Each player can add a game modifier. ( Activated from option menu )
- [Added] A proper Title screen
- [Added] BGM for tile and character select screen
- [Gfx] new missile explosions FX
- [Gfx] new background for level
- [fixed] falling rocks no longer make the game crash
- [fixed] missiles now warp correctly
